mapper.select: SELECT ma.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(ma.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , ma.TR_CD , ma.FUND_CD , ma.TRUSTEE , ma.CURRENCY , ma.TR_SEQ , ma.TR_AEK , ma.WON_TR_AEK , ma.BAL_AEK , ma.WON_BAL_AEK , ma.TAX_AEK , ma.WON_TAX_AEK , TO_CHAR(ma.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , ma.FCUR_TR_AEK AS syt0ma_fcur_tr_aek , ma.FCUR_BAL_AEK AS syt0ma_fcur_bal_aek , 1 AS p_visible , ma.FUND_CD AS orig_fund_cd , ma.TRUSTEE AS orig_trustee , ma.CURRENCY AS orig_currency , ma.TR_SEQ AS orig_tr_seq , TO_CHAR(ma.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS orig_gyulje_ymd FROM SYT0MA ma JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = ma.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = ma.FUND_CD WHERE ma.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ma.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ma.TR_CD = #{trCd} ORDER BY ma.FUND_CD ASC , ma.TRUSTEE ASC , ma.CURRENCY ASC , ma.TR_SEQ ASC

SELECT t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , t1.TRUSTEE AS trustee , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , ia.FUND_CURRENCY AS fundCurrency , COALESCE(t1.BFIL_AEK, 0) + COALESCE(t1.UP_AEK, 0) - COALESCE(t1.DW_AEK, 0) AS balAek , COALESCE(t1.WON_BFIL_AEK, 0) + COALESCE(t1.WON_UP_AEK, 0) - COALESCE(t1.WON_DW_AEK, 0) AS wonBalAek FROM SYT0MC t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.TR_CD = CASE #{trCd} WHEN 'H21' THEN 'P40' WHEN 'H22' THEN 'P41' END ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.TRUSTEE ASC , t1.CURRENCY ASC

SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SYT0MA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_CD IN ( SELECT ta.TR_CD FROM SZX1PT ta WHERE ta.OBJ_ID IN ('W_JA035M', 'W_SJA035M') ) ORDER BY ymd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYT0MA ( CORP_GR , TR_YMD , TR_CD , FUND_CD , TRUSTEE , CURRENCY , TR_SEQ , TR_AEK , WON_TR_AEK , BAL_AEK , WON_BAL_AEK , TAX_AEK , WON_TAX_AEK , GYULJE_YMD , FCUR_TR_AEK , FCUR_BAL_AEK ) VALUES ( #{corpGr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , #{trCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{fundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{trustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , COALESCE(#{trSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1) , COALESCE(#{trAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonTrAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{balAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonBalAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{taxAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , COALESCE(#{wonTaxAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{gyuljeYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , #{syt0maFcurTrAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{syt0maFcurBalAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYT0MA WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TR_CD = #{trCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FUND_CD = COALESCE(#{origFundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND TRUSTEE = COALESCE(#{origTrustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND CURRENCY = COALESCE(#{origCurrency, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND TR_SEQ = COALESCE(#{origTrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) AND GYULJE_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(COALESCE(#{origGyuljeYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gyuljeYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
